description: Hover images in real Positron: (1) pixel columns px0..px63 draw an 8x8 image in the tooltip; (2) an image-path column loads the PNG into the tooltip (the img actually decodes).
setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, zlib, struct, os
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
n = 600
k = rng.integers(0, 3, n)
px = np.clip(rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 64)) + k[:, None] * 2, 0, None)
df = pd.DataFrame(px, columns=[f'px{i}' for i in range(64)])
df['cluster'] = [f'c{v}' for v in k]
d = '/tmp/positron-atlas-e2e/imgs'
os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
def _png(path, rgb):
    w = h = 16
    raw = b''.join(b'\x00' + bytes(rgb) * w for _ in range(h))
    def ch(t, data):
        return struct.pack('>I', len(data)) + t + data + struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(t + data) & 0xffffffff)
    open(path, 'wb').write(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n' + ch(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB', w, h, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0)) + ch(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(raw)) + ch(b'IEND', b''))
for j, c in enumerate([(220, 40, 40), (40, 180, 60), (40, 80, 220)]):
    _png(f'{d}/img{j}.png', c)
df['image_path'] = [f'{d}/img{v}.png' for v in k]

steps.name: pixel image ('Points are images'): hover a point, the tooltip draws its pixels
steps.eval: a.setView({ images: true }); a.tooltipOpts = { ...a.tooltipOpts, imageUrlColumn: undefined }; a.tooltip = null; a.rowCache.clear(); const xy = a.anchorXY; for (let i = 0; i < 4 && !(a.tooltip && a.tooltip.image); i++) { const p = a.renderer.projectWorld(xy[0], xy[1]); a['onPointer']({ x: p[0], y: p[1], world: [xy[0], xy[1]] }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 150)); }
steps.until: a.tooltip && a.tooltip.image && (() => { const c = document.querySelector('.tooltip canvas'); if (!c) return false; const px = c.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; for (let i = 3; i < px.length; i += 4) if (px[i] > 0) return true; return false; })()
steps.report: { shape: a.imageShape, hasImage: !!(a.tooltip && a.tooltip.image), canvas: !!document.querySelector('.tooltip canvas'), painted: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('.tooltip canvas'); if (!c) return 0; const d = c.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; let n = 0; for (let i = 3; i < d.length; i += 4) if (d[i] > 0) n++; return n; })() }

steps.name: image URL column: the tooltip loads and decodes the PNG
steps.eval: a.setView({ images: false }); a.tooltipOpts = { ...a.tooltipOpts, imageUrlColumn: a.describe.columns.find((c) => c.name === 'image_path').index }; a.loadImagesFromUrls = 'always'; a.tooltip = null; a.rowCache.clear(); const xy = a.anchorXY; for (let i = 0; i < 5 && !(a.tooltip && a.tooltip.imageUri); i++) { const p = a.renderer.projectWorld(xy[2], xy[3]); a['onPointer']({ x: p[0], y: p[1], world: [xy[2], xy[3]] }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); }
steps.report: { uri: a.tooltip && a.tooltip.imageUri, img: (() => { const im = document.querySelector('.tooltip img'); return im ? { complete: im.complete, w: im.naturalWidth } : null; })() }

steps.name: the PNG decoded (naturalWidth 16)
steps.until: (() => { const im = document.querySelector('.tooltip img'); return im && im.complete && im.naturalWidth === 16; })()
